rejected.title: Need for travel and shopping research apps
rejected.reason: The post asks whether users will need specialized travel or shopping research apps, but gives no concrete task, repeated chore, or request to solve one. Without a bounded existing chore, a proposed service and customer would be invented.

rejected.title: Pinterest publishing node capabilities
rejected.reason: This maker post describes a built Pinterest node and lists schedules, batch publishing, CSV import, board checks, uploads, analytics, and webhooks. It does not state an unmet chore or request for help; turning these product capabilities into a demand signal would invent one.

steps.message: Assessed both assigned discussion identities. Neither source supplies a concrete existing chore suitable for a demand first experiment, so no post is proposed.
